sources.title: Sinker EDM
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: 線切割放電加工
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付電極補償圖、三截面量測與磨耗假說。；教學槽寬允收 10.00±0.02 mm，須檢三深度且另列角部半徑，不只驗入口。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver electrode compensation geometry, three sections and wear hypotheses.; Teaching width 10.00±0.02 mm must pass at three depths with corner radius reported separately.
related.difference: 從線徑與間隙計算切縫及最小內角半徑，檢查圖面可製造性。
related.differenceEn: Compute kerf and minimum internal radius from wire diameter and gap to check manufacturability.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 對稱側向間隙 g 下，Welectrode=Wcavity−2g。；教學槽寬 10.00 mm，兩側間隙各 0.020 mm。；We=10.00−2×0.020=9.960 mm。
切縫 w=d+2g；簡化內角半徑 Rmin=d/2+g。；教學線徑 d=0.20 mm、側間隙 g=0.015 mm。；w=0.20+2×0.015=0.230 mm；Rmin=0.115 mm。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: With symmetric side gap g, Welectrode=Wcavity−2g.; Teaching cavity width 10.00 mm with 0.020 mm gap on each side.; We=10.00−2×0.020=9.960 mm.
Kerf w=d+2g and simplified minimum internal radius Rmin=d/2+g.; Teaching wire diameter d=0.20 mm and side gap g=0.015 mm.; w=0.20+2×0.015=0.230 mm; Rmin=0.115 mm.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 工業粉末燒結
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付電極補償圖、三截面量測與磨耗假說。；教學槽寬允收 10.00±0.02 mm，須檢三深度且另列角部半徑，不只驗入口。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver electrode compensation geometry, three sections and wear hypotheses.; Teaching width 10.00±0.02 mm must pass at three depths with corner radius reported separately.
related.difference: 在質量守恆前提下連接相對密度與體積，並指出脫脂期間不能直接套用同一質量。
related.differenceEn: Connect relative density and volume under mass conservation, identifying why debinding violates an unchanged-mass assumption.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 對稱側向間隙 g 下，Welectrode=Wcavity−2g。；教學槽寬 10.00 mm，兩側間隙各 0.020 mm。；We=10.00−2×0.020=9.960 mm。
相同金屬質量下 Vfinal/Vinitial=ρinitial/ρfinal；等向線性比為體積比的立方根。 教學金屬粉體骨架相對密度從 0.75 到 0.95，初始長度 20 mm，忽略氧化與各向異性。 V比=0.75/0.95=0.78947；Lfinal=20×(0.75/0.95)^(1/3)=18.485 mm，線收縮約 7.58%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: With symmetric side gap g, Welectrode=Wcavity−2g.; Teaching cavity width 10.00 mm with 0.020 mm gap on each side.; We=10.00−2×0.020=9.960 mm.

At fixed metal mass Vfinal/Vinitial=ρ initial/ρ final; isotropic linear ratio is the cube root of that volume ratio. Teaching relative density increases from 0.75 to 0.95; initial length 20 mm; neglect oxidation and anisotropy. Volume ratio=0.75/0.95=0.78947; Lfinal=20×(0.75/0.95)^(1/3)=18.485 mm, approximately 7.58% linear shrinkage.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
